relations: Cloud layers drift at different rates, changing the left bank's shape while the diagonal cirrus band remains fixed.
The small white cumulus puff near upper center becomes more distinct and stays nearly fixed as nearby streaks shift.
Brighter white cloud mass extends into the upper-left from the left bank, while its right edge protrusion moves modestly.
Isolated dark specks appear briefly without forming a continuing object, as the sky's gradual motion continues.
caption: The video captures a daytime sky with deep blue, a layered gray-and-white cloud bank at lower-left, a faint diagonal wispy band across the right, and scattered top wisps. A small white cumulus puff near upper center becomes more distinct and stays nearly fixed as nearby streaks shift. The left bank changes shape, with brighter white cloud mass extending into upper-left and its right edge protrusion moving modestly. The diagonal cirrus band on the right remains largely fixed, and bottom-right horizon clouds stay largely in place. The differing movements appear as slow drift of separate cloud layers rather than one uniform sweep. A few isolated dark specks appear only briefly and do not form a continuing visible object. The sky is still changing, with the bank continuing its gradual motion and the upper puff slowly evolving.
